annotations.title: FD ladder with your own amounts and rates

description: Maturity of a set of fixed deposits with different amounts, tenures and rates (an FD ladder), as Indian banks pay it: simple interest under 6 months, compounded quarterly from 6 months. Returns each FD's maturity and interest, and the totals. For an equal split of one amount, fd_laddering_calculator is simpler.
